evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions concerns or stressors about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?" — asked after storage/oversized-item/fragile/packing/box/parking probing was already complete
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: "Last time it was somewhat rushed and they damaged items, several items... can[dled] they be efficient with their time but not... rushing" — a real, specific concern (repeat-damage worry on a new custom bedroom set); rep only acknowledged it ("I'll take note of that... give our guys a heads-up") without a real second-layer follow-up
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "you only pay for how long it takes after the two and a half hour minimum" (beats-it-pay-less) + variable-hours framing on the packing/moving quote (window); no rate-commitment, self-prep-tip, or fairness-check lines

top_strength: Handled a demanding, detail-heavy repeat customer (discount request, insurance questions, day-by-day rate breakdown) calmly and consistently without over-promising or getting flustered.
coaching_note: The customer explicitly flagged a repeat-damage concern from a prior move on a brand-new custom bedroom set — that deserved real two-layer follow-up (what got damaged, what would reassure them this time), not a one-line acknowledgment, and the call ended without any explicit ask or rate-lock close.
